purpose: Exercise and settlement style by instrument. Read by the early-assignment check in stage 4 (contract check C8) and by sizing in stage 5. Only instruments that differ from the default need an entry.

default.note: A short option can be assigned at any time before expiry, most often just before an ex-dividend date when it is in the money.

SPX.note: Index option. Standard monthly contracts settle on the opening price of the third Friday; weekly and end-of-month contracts settle on the close.

XSP.note: Mini index option, one tenth of SPX. Uses SPX price history in this system.

caveats: Distribution frequency is a general description, not a schedule. Ex-dividend dates have no data source yet, so check C8 reports the dividend part as could not be checked.
Confirm contract specifications with the exchange before relying on them for an instrument not listed here.
